newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises led by surprise high cap gains.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises led by surprise high cap gains.

text.p: The Czech PX50 rose 0.6 percent to 512.2 on Monday with gains to high caps bewildering some local dealers who had expected falls in the wake of poor first half earnings results.
The two most unlikely gainers were Komercni Banka, which soared more than three percent to 1,685 and power utility CEZ which posted a respectable 0.5 percent rise to 923.
Referring to the two companies, Jan Sykora, a dealer at Wood and Company said: "I think they should be on the contrary going down...we are getting summer abnormalities."
On Friday, CEZ announced that its after tax profit in the first half of 1997 had fallen to 3.53 billion crowns compared with 5.95 billion in the same period last year.
The day before, Komercni posted net first half profits of 1.64 billion crowns down from 2.53 in the first half last year.
Generally, activity was low with turnover at a little over 550 million crowns.
